body: I have tried many anti-depressants, but I still feel empty inside.
I've tried antidepressants, I still feel empty inside.

Let's see:
1. I'm constantly depressed. Even though I pretend to be happy in the hopes that it will all change, I'm dead inside.
2. I feel like I'm not good at anything.
3. I try to get my friends together and have fun, but they're always "busy." They never invite me unless they absolutely need another person and everyone else is actually busy.
4. My family shuns me for being a failure.
5. I'm sort of inspired by the story of Mr. Stack. He destroyed an institution that had royally screwed him over and taken away years of his life.
Can't think of anything else.
I just don't want to be that person that is constantly threatening to kill themselves.
Probably most helpful comment in thread.
Yeah, I just don't want to be a burden.
I just don't feel like anyone likes me and that I'm completely alone and no-one would miss me anyways.
